isps.source: GoatCounter isp/* events via scripts/fetch_visitors.py, enriched with RIR delegated stats (APNIC first) and RDAP holder names. Test events are excluded from published counts.
isps.note: ISP data is ASN-level and comes from a third-party lookup on each new visit. The visitor IP is sent only to that lookup service, never stored here or sent to GoatCounter. Past visits cannot be backfilled because GoatCounter does not store IP addresses.
